prompts.optionA_roof_sign.png:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: idle racing game concept art for Godot, single portrait PNG, exactly 1024x1536 pixels, opaque, full-bleed scene fills every edge.
Input images: first supplied local reference is STYLE reference only: match its soft miniature toy diorama material, rounded forms, pastel grass and trees, gentle shadows, cream-trimmed teal money sign with green banknote icon. Second image is NEGATIVE reference only: avoid the giant round money balloon and long vertical stalk, and avoid oversized rank UI.
Scene: elevated isometric top-down three-quarter view of a curved gray racetrack with coral-and-cream curbs, soft grass and rounded toy trees. Exactly three small toy racing cars, player car teal, other two pastel coral and yellow. One prominent ROOFED GRANDSTAND beside the curve is the revenue source: clearly visible stepped rows of seats filled with little rounded toy spectators, canopy roof, small flags, cream structural frame. Make the grandstand the standout roadside object, not a gas station, shop or kiosk. Its open front faces camera and track, so the seating tiers and audience are unmistakable.
Style: high-quality soft miniature 3D clay/toy diorama, matte rounded surfaces, subtly tactile finish, pastel palette, soft daylight and contact shadows. Coherent game-scale objects, no realistic people.
Player UI: ONE very small compact rounded rectangular tag bearing the exact text "P3/8" immediately above and attached visually to the teal car, only a tiny gap, NO stalk, NO round bubble. Tag much smaller than car.
Revenue text: exact "+$120" with a green money icon immediately left. Render all text sharply, legibly and verbatim. These are the only two texts in the image. No headings, variant letters, watermark, borders, floating HUD, detached money bubble, long poles connecting labels, large rank labels, or white empty margins.

Revenue design A: a horizontal 3D pill-shaped physical sign directly seated flush on top of the grandstand canopy roof, with cream rounded bevel border, dark teal face, green stack-of-banknotes icon and white "+$120". The sign is integrated with the roof, no gap and no supporting stalk. Make it readable and prominent but sized as an architectural rooftop sign. No scoreboard, no banner and no income beam.
